description: This file implements the SystemAudioPlayer plugin class for the WPEFramework. It manages initialization, deinitialization, and lifecycle of the SystemAudioPlayer component, including registration, configuration, and cleanup routines. It also registers the plugin as a service and interacts with remote connections.

classes.name: SystemAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main plugin class that manages the lifecycle and interactions of the system audio player within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the audio player, registers notifications, and prepares the service for operation.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases the audio player instance.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation events, triggers appropriate cleanup or state changes.
